task: Add a pre-merge independent-review gate: a required `independent-review` commit status bound to the PR head SHA, posted by the independent reviewer via a helper

events.summary: In the sibling repo beluga, PRs were self-merged seconds after CI went green, before an independent review finished; no check ties merge to a review that postdates the last push

Design review found that a pull_request workflow runs the PR's own gate script and committer.date is author-forgeable, so the label+timestamp design was dropped; the control is now a commit status on the head SHA (new push = new SHA = no status), with no workflow and no timestamps

Added scripts/ci/mark-review-pass.py (refuses draft or non-open PRs, requires exactly one literal full 40-hex --sha (no abbreviations, repeats or --sha=) of the reviewed commit (no prefixes) and refuses unless it equals the PR head, posts the status on exactly that SHA, re-reads the head and prints a warning instead of success (exit 1) if it moved), its unit tests and one AGENTS.md note; no existing policy, workflow or gate was weakened

scripts/ci/tests (incl. new plan_status and injected-gh main-path tests asserting the exact status POST) pass; mutation checks confirmed failure when the reviewed-SHA mismatch check is disabled, the exact-argv check is loosened to accept flag abbreviations or a repeated --sha, the status context string is changed, the open-state check is disabled and the draft check is weakened, then restored; make validate, make test (289 passed, 0 failed) and shellcheck pass

The helper posts the independent-review status only for an open, ready PR whose current head equals the SHA the reviewer names; the check becomes merge-blocking once the owner marks it required after this PR merges. It is a procedural control, not identity-proof
Gate implemented and unit-verified; live behavior is verified on the first PRs after rollout
